facts.quote: Finished export files are kept for 30 days, then deleted.
A lifecycle rule on exports-prod deletes export files 30 days after they are written.
From 1 May, export files for Enterprise plans are kept for 90 days.
All other plans stay at 30 days.
Your export is kept for 7 days.
You can export up to 24 months at a time.
A customer can export up to 24 months of invoices in one request.
Each export request covers at most 12 months of invoices, to keep the nightly run under its 06:00 UTC deadline.
